description: This file defines a minimal fetch helper for frontend services in a JavaScript project, specifically for a React application. It includes functions for URL handling, JSON fetching with error handling, and a public API for making consistent HTTP requests.

methods.name: joinUrl(baseWithTrailingSlash, pathNoLeadingSlash)
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path, handling slashes correctly.

methods.name: normalizeEndpoint(url)
methods.description: Ensures the URL ends with a trailing slash for consistency.

methods.name: tryReadJson(resp)
methods.description: Attempts to parse response as JSON, returns null on failure.

methods.name: tryReadText(resp)
methods.description: Attempts to read response as text, returns empty string on failure.

methods.name: toErrorMessage({ json, text, status })
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message based on JSON or text response.

methods.name: getBackendBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the configured backend URL with a trailing slash or empty string if not set.

methods.name: apiFetchJson(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to an API endpoint, ensuring a consistent response shape with robust error handling.

ctags.name: apiFetchJson
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiFetchJson(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative/
ctags.signature: (path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
